overal.goal: packages/shared/src/store.ts: transition() does locate + assertTransition + read before taking the lock, and the lock is per destination path, so two moves of the same task from the same source both succeed; save() writes at the in-memory status path with no re-locate; create() overwrites an existing id (lockedAtomicWrite without an exclusive flag). Consequences seen in review: archive racing the engine's claim leaves ongoing/<id>/task.md and archived/<id>.md; reorder racing pending→running recreates pending/<id>.md and the next tick starts a second pipeline; a manual plan sync overlapping autoSync creates the task twice and the later transition fails with InvalidTransitionError. Take one lock per task id around locate+check+move, re-locate inside save(), make create() refuse an existing id (wx), and hold a per-plan lock in syncOnce. Add tests for each race.
overal.stack: TypeScript monorepo (Node 22 / Bun), Hono server, React + Vite UI, vitest

rules.do: Read README.md and docs/boof-runner.md for the intended behaviour before changing code.
Write a failing test first, then make it pass; keep the change focused on this goal.
Run `npm run typecheck && npm test` and `npm run lint` before finishing.
rules.dont: Do not change public API or MCP shapes without updating docs/api.md and the OpenAPI document.
Do not commit secrets, data roots or build output.

versions.version: Identified during the 2026-10-27 review; not started.

Every TaskStore writer runs locate, check and write under one per-task-id lock; save re-locates; create refuses an existing id with TaskExistsError (exclusive atomic write); syncPlan holds a per-plan lock.

tests.strategy: Unit tests with vitest for the changed module; an integration test through the Hono app or CLI where the behaviour is observable there.
